en.title: Barry Loser Animated Series Lands Italian Partners Ahead of MIA Market
en.summary: The beloved U.K. children's book series 'Barry Loser' is officially getting the animated treatment. Italian production partners have been secured for the adaptation.
en.body:
The world of children's literature is about to get a whole lot funnier on screen. **Barry Loser**, the award-winning and million-selling book series by **Jim Smith**, is officially being developed into an animated series. U.K.-based **Big Little Fish Television** has partnered with Italian outfit **Frog Head** to bring the trials and tribulations of the most-boringly named protagonist in the world to animated life. This exciting collaboration is set to be a key project pitched at Rome’s newly launched Animation Series Gap-Financing Market during the upcoming MIA Market.

First published in 2012, **Jim Smith**'s **Barry Loser** franchise has spawned over ten books, capturing the imagination of young readers worldwide. The series, celebrated for its silly jokes, pranks, and plenty of burps and farts, even snagged the prestigious Roald Dahl Funny Prize in 2013. With translations in 17 languages and sales exceeding one million copies, Barry's adventures have resonated deeply with a global fanbase. The books often follow Barry as he navigates the everyday challenges of being a ten-year-old, from dealing with parental bans on gaming to striving to be a 'Total Winner'. The creative team also includes the **RCW Literary Agency** and **The Artists Partnership**, underscoring the significant industry backing behind this project.

## A Win for Young Fans

For the millions of fans who grew up with Barry's misadventures, this animated adaptation represents a significant moment. The series' consistent popularity and critical acclaim, including the Roald Dahl Funny Prize, highlight its strong appeal. By translating the book's distinct humor and visual style, the animation has the potential to introduce **Barry Loser** to a new generation of binge-watchers, while also delighting long-time readers. The partnership with Italian producers also hints at a broader international vision for the series, aiming to capture a global audience with Barry's relatable, albeit chaotic, childhood experiences.

## What's Next

While specific broadcast or streaming details have not yet been announced, the project's presence at the MIA Market signals active development and a push to secure further partnerships. Fans can anticipate more updates on casting, animation style, and potential release windows as the project progresses through its financing and production stages.

content_raw: “Barry Loser,” the award-winning, million-selling children’s book series from creator Jim Smith, is being adapted into an animated series by the U.K.’s Big Little Fish Television and Italian co-producer Frog Head. It’s one of the projects that will be pitched to industry reps during the newly launched Animation Series Gap-Financing Market at Rome’s MIA Market. […]
